DESCRIPTION
This manual page documents briefly the &dhpackage; command.
This manual page was written for the &debian; distribution because the original program does not have a manual page.
&dhpackage; is a program that finds directories.
OPTIONS
These programs follow the usual &gnu; command line syntax, with long options starting with two dashes (`-'). A summary of options is included below. For a complete description, see the Info files.
-i
Case insensitive.
-r
Search from root directory.
-d
Search in hidden directories.
-H
List the history.
SEE ALSO
This program is fully documented in http://arco.inf-cr.uclm.es/~david.villa/go2.html
